edition.notes: Popular Hindi aarti 'Jai Kali Mata'. Line-order varies by region (as with Hanuman aarti). This is a widely printed eight-couplet temple form, not a tantric paddhati.

description.hi: माँ काली की सन्ध्या आरती — घर और मन्दिर की लोक-परम्परा।
description.en: Evening aarti of Maa Kali — household and temple folk tradition.
